title: Star button
description: A button for starring an item, with a counter. The star morphs into a filled one when you press it, and the count goes up.
pageTitle: Star Button with Animated Counter (Like & Upvote) | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it for actions where the count matters: starring a repository, liking a post or upvoting a feature request. The star morph and the updated count reward the click and show at a glance how many others engaged. Place it near the item's title, where people expect social proof.
whenToUse.alt: Animated star button with counter: star morphs into a filled star on click and the count goes up

accessibility: Visually hidden text completes the name, so screen readers hear "24 stars" instead of a bare number.
The animated star is decorative and hidden from assistive tech.
iconsNote: This icon button with a counter uses a System Outline icon with the Morph state. Swap the star for a heart, a bookmark or any other System Outline icon with a Morph state. Icons with the default Hover state work too, but instead of turning solid, they play the full animation and only change color.
